2027 or 2028 BMW M5 LCI (Neue Klasse) Sheds the Camouflage in CGI, Dresses in Ritzy Hues
8 photos
Photo: avarvarii / Instagram
The premium Bavarian automaker BMW has a lot of upcoming new and refreshed models, and some of them are feisty while others are quite practical. No worries, all of them will appear in due time – or a little in advance, sometime.
BMW is currently ready to pay insane money – up to $730k – to its employees to quit, as it wants to get rid of 8k of its workforce by the end of 2027, according to a recent report. They’re reshaping the manpower, but the upcoming new models won’t be affected. At least that’s clear from the latest spied prototypes – our spy photographers can’t get enough camera memory to cover all the upcoming BMWs.
Those include the upcoming BMW i3 Touring but also the high-performance BMW M3 and M5 models, of which one is all-new and coming with both ICE and EV options and the other is a classic LCI – or Life Cycle Impulse – aka a mid-cycle refresh procedure. There are even more on the horizon, even though BMW just unveiled the first-ever iX4 and a bunch of new engine options across the board, among other things.
Of course, the rumor mill is highly invested in the performance BMWs, and a member of the imaginative guild of digital car content creators dwelling across the parallel universes of vehicular CGI has decided to cover the hot subject of the upcoming M5 facelift .
So, later this year or early in 2027 for the 2027 or 2028 model year, the refreshed BMW M5 will arrive complete with revised styling and, once again, the electrified V8 under the hood. The current eighth generation BMW 5 Series G60 was introduced in the spring of 2023, and the G90/99 BMW M5 sedan and M5 Touring quickly appeared during the same year.
As such, it’s not too old, but BMW is hurrying to bring to Neue Klasse snuff all of its most important models, and the 5 Series and M5 will follow in the footsteps of the flagship 7 Series and i7 but feature Neue Klasse styling both inside and outside on this occasion, according to the most recent spied prototypes.
Now, Andrei Avarvarii, the virtual artist behind Avarvarii Automotive Artworks (also known as ' avarvarii ' on social media), has taken a thorough, in-depth CGI look at BMW's upcoming plans and decided to ‘unmask’ the BMW M5. Free from the constraints of the dizzying camouflage, the unofficial, hypothetical BMW M5 design project shows a tamer version of the Neue Klasse styling, as, unlike the latest BMW 3 Series, for example, it will keep the separate kidney grilles.
Otherwise, the rendering is inspired by the latest Neue Klasse models, as seen in the headlight and LED daytime running lights treatment or the front bumper style. The profile won’t change much, and most likely the rear won’t be touched extensively, either. On the other hand, we surely expect the BMW 5 Series and M5 to switch to the controversial BMW Panoramic Vision for the cockpit.
